unfold allVowels allVowels_postcond
  have h_main : allVowels_postcond (s) (allVowels (s) h_precond) h_precond := by
    dsimp [allVowels_postcond, allVowels, allVowels_precond] at *
    <;>
    (try trivial) <;>
    (try simp_all) <;>
    (try aesop) <;>
    (try ring_nf) <;>
    (try norm_num) <;>
    (try simp_all [Char.toNat_add, Char.toNat_zero, Nat.add_assoc]) <;>
    (try aesop) <;>
    (try ring_nf) <;>
    (try norm_num) <;>
    (try simp_all [Char.toNat_add, Char.toNat_zero, Nat.add_assoc]) <;>
    (try aesop)
    <;>
    simp_all [Char.toNat_add, Char.toNat_zero, Nat.add_assoc]
    <;>
    aesop

  exact h_main
